summary: Quote, then Depth, on one equity: the instrument moves from QUOTE to SNAP_QUOTE and back as subscriptions come and go, and the last release unsubscribes it.

deviations.reason: The web's Angel adapter sends data.mode its own way (the subscription mode number, or no key); the desktop sends its label (ltp, quote, full). Lead rule 2026-11-09: this follows each broker's own web adapter (lane wire's per-broker dialect switch; bk-a sets the entry in phase B).

Angel sends the book totals as doubles and the web passes the double on (1000.0); the desktop sends an integer (1000). A JSON number type is not a web defect: Lead rule 2026-11-09: this follows each broker's own web adapter (lane wire's per-broker dialect switch; bk-a sets the entry in phase B).
